findings.motion: AB 1116 Assembly Third Reading, Senate floor
findings.note: Voted aye on the Senate floor (29 to 9) on AB 1116, which lets a person register online without a driver's license or state ID, with identity checked by other data such as the last four digits of a Social Security number. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy. The page lists this vote under 2026-08-24 and repeats it under 2026-10-19; the Governor vetoed the bill on 2026-09-27 per that page.
subjects: identity check to register to vote

findings.motion: Senate Appropriations Committee: do pass as amended
